name: Hassan Siddiqi
title: Professional development trainer and leadership coach
bio_short: Professional development trainer with more than 10 years' corporate training and senior management experience. Clients include Shell, Aramco, Samsung and Abu Dhabi Global Markets. Toastmasters champion speaker. Delivers in English and Arabic.
bio: Hassan is a professional development trainer with more than 10 years' corporate training experience alongside a career in senior commercial roles. Before becoming a full-time trainer, Hassan held senior management positions leading multinational teams to grow digital businesses including YallaMotor.com, Bayt.com and GulfNews.com, giving him commercial credibility and a direct understanding of the pressures facing business leaders.  His corporate training clients include Shell, Aramco, Samsung International, Abu Dhabi Global Markets and BAE Systems. He holds dual certifications in learning and development: a Certified Training and Development Professional (CTDP) from Canada and a CIPD Level 5 Diploma in Learning and Development. He is a division-level champion speaker at Toastmasters International.  At ISOC, Hassan delivers public speaking, leadership, negotiation skills, interpersonal skills and executive communication programmes. His combination of digital business leadership and professional training credentials gives him a practical credibility that resonates with participants at all levels. He helps individuals and teams build skills in strategic communication, leadership presence and interpersonal effectiveness. His approach blends rigorous preparation with high-energy facilitation, and he is particularly effective at helping participants develop confidence and presence in high-stakes professional settings. Hassan is based in Dubai and trains in English and Arabic.
